name: perch-monorepo
description: Perch: a self-hosted agentic workspace. IDE + team chat + bots + connections + model gateway, in one TypeScript monorepo on Bun.

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.e2e: echo 'e2e arrives with task 0.8 (Playwright against the laptop-mode server)' && exit 0
scripts.perf: echo 'perf audit arrives with task 2.20; bundle budget check lands in 0.15' && exit 0
scripts.sdk:generate: bun run --filter @perch/api openapi:export && bun run --filter @perch/api-client generate
